boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten nearby, under-21-friendly public places and activities with documented free admission or free use.

cards.title: See the animals at Como Park Zoo
cards.subtitle: Como Regional Park, Saint Paul
cards.notes: Enter during posted visitor hours and follow exhibit signage. Admission is free, with an optional donation; skip paid rentals and concessions for a no-cost visit.
cards.short_summary: A free animal-viewing outing in Como Regional Park.
cards.evidence_claim: Como Park Zoo states that admission is free and visitors are welcome whether or not they make the suggested voluntary donation.
cards.source_title: Visitor Map & Hours | Como Park Zoo & Conservatory
cards.access_notes: Open daily; the official visitor page lists seasonal hours. Optional donations and paid rentals are not required for entry.

cards.title: Walk the Conservatory gardens
cards.subtitle: Como Regional Park, Saint Paul
cards.notes: Use the visitor map to choose a garden route and take time with the seasonal displays. Keep the outing free by declining the optional donation and rentals.
cards.short_summary: Indoor plant collections and seasonal displays with free admission.
cards.evidence_claim: Como Park Zoo and Marjorie McNeely Conservatory state that they are free and that everyone is welcome without making a donation.
cards.source_title: Policies & FAQ | Como Park Zoo & Conservatory
cards.access_notes: Official page lists seasonal daily visitor hours. The suggested donation is voluntary; photography rules apply.

cards.title: Browse Mia’s permanent collection
cards.subtitle: 2400 Third Avenue South, Minneapolis
cards.notes: Walk into the permanent-collection galleries without a ticket and pick one wing to explore together. Confirm an exhibition is not ticketed before adding it to your route.
cards.short_summary: A no-ticket museum outing centered on the permanent collection.
cards.evidence_claim: The Minneapolis Institute of Art says general admission to its permanent collection is always free and requires no ticket or reservation.
cards.source_title: Visit the Minneapolis Institute of Art—Always Free
cards.access_notes: Open Tuesday–Sunday, with late hours on Thursday. Special exhibitions and some events can require tickets.

cards.title: Take a Capitol self-guided tour
cards.subtitle: 75 Rev. Dr. Martin Luther King, Jr. Blvd., Saint Paul
cards.notes: Start at the information desk, then use the official itinerary to seek out the rotunda, chambers, and public art. A self-guided visit does not require a purchase.
cards.short_summary: A free public-building exploration of art, architecture, and government spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: Minnesota Historical Society states that admission to the Minnesota State Capitol is free and that self-guided tours are available.
cards.source_title: Hours and Admission | Minnesota State Capitol
cards.access_notes: Official page lists public building hours and free guided-tour times. Guided-tour donations are suggested, not required.

cards.title: Stroll the Minneapolis Sculpture Garden
cards.subtitle: 725 Vineland Place, Minneapolis
cards.notes: Take a self-guided loop through the outdoor works and gardens, then use the free digital guide if you want context for specific pieces. No ticket is needed.
cards.short_summary: An all-year outdoor art walk with free public access.
cards.evidence_claim: Walker Art Center says the Minneapolis Sculpture Garden requires no tickets and is always free to the public.
cards.source_title: Minneapolis Sculpture Garden | Walker Art Center
cards.access_notes: Open daily, year-round, 6 a.m.–midnight according to Walker Art Center.

cards.title: Swim or sit by Phalen Beach
cards.subtitle: 1400 Phalen Drive, Saint Paul
cards.notes: Bring what you need for a beach afternoon and use the guarded sand beach during its posted season. Watercraft rentals are optional and not part of this free plan.
cards.short_summary: A seasonal, guarded public beach with free admission.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Paul Parks and Recreation identifies Phalen Park Beach as having free admission and free parking.
cards.source_title: Phalen Regional Park Beach | Saint Paul Minnesota
cards.access_notes: Seasonal and weather-dependent; consult the city page for guarded beach hours. Rentals and some programs cost extra.

cards.title: Cool off at Parque Castillo’s splash pad
cards.subtitle: Parque Castillo, 149 Cesar Chavez St., Saint Paul
cards.notes: Visit during the seasonal splash-pad window and pair it with the playground or public art. Bring water and sun protection; no paid aquatic admission is required.
cards.short_summary: A free seasonal splash-pad stop in Saint Paul’s West Side.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Paul Parks and Recreation says splash pads, including Parque Castillo, are available free of charge during summer.
cards.source_title: Aquatics Frequently Asked Questions | Saint Paul Minnesota
cards.access_notes: Seasonal; Parque Castillo’s facility page lists splash-pad hours as 9 a.m.–9 p.m. Confirm conditions before traveling.

cards.title: Make a summer stop at Conway Park Splash Pad
cards.subtitle: Conway Park, Saint Paul
cards.notes: Use this as a simple warm-weather meet-up and keep it purchase-free by using the city’s public splash pad. Check seasonal conditions before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A city-listed free splash-pad activity for summer.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Paul Parks and Recreation lists Conway Park among splash pads available to use free of charge during summer.
cards.source_title: Aquatics Frequently Asked Questions | Saint Paul Minnesota
cards.access_notes: Seasonal outdoor amenity; the city’s aquatics FAQ directs visitors to confirm location details and conditions.

cards.title: Use the Roy Wilkins Park splash pad
cards.subtitle: Roy Wilkins Park, Saint Paul
cards.notes: Plan a daytime summer meet-up around the splash pad and nearby park amenities. This activity needs no paid pool pass; verify seasonal operation before you leave.
cards.short_summary: A free seasonal splash-pad outing in a Saint Paul public park.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Paul Parks and Recreation lists Roy Wilkins Park among splash pads available to use free of charge during summer.
cards.source_title: Aquatics Frequently Asked Questions | Saint Paul Minnesota
cards.access_notes: Seasonal outdoor amenity; check current city information before visiting.

cards.title: Settle into the St. Kate library
cards.subtitle: Coeur de Catherine, first floor, St. Catherine University
cards.notes: Meet a classmate to study, work independently, use a computer, or ask a librarian for help. This is a St. Kate student resource; campus access and parking rules apply.
cards.short_summary: A campus study-and-connect space with documented free student services.
cards.evidence_claim: St. Catherine University states that library services are free and describes study space, print resources, computers, and group study rooms for students.
cards.source_title: University Resources for Parents and Families | St. Catherine University
cards.access_notes: Located in Coeur de Catherine’s first floor. The university notes that campus parking is permit-only on weekdays from 7 a.m.–5 p.m.
